answer: Locks are written down in relic, expire in tundra, and vault lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 41 aliases therefore needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 143 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
